tools.name: list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List lead form submissions from the 2026 table, optionally filtered by date range, language, lead type or quality.

start_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) lower bound on created_at.

end_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) upper bound on created_at.

type.description: Lead magnet type, e.g. stalen, lookbook, korting, keukentrends.

kwaliteit.description: Lead quality label, e.g. Goed, Redelijk, Slecht.

tools.name: lead_funnel_summary
tools.title: Lead funnel summary
tools.description: Summarise the 2026 lead funnel (Leads → MQL → SQL) for a date range, broken down by market and lead type. SQL excludes keukentrends leads.

start_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) lower bound on created_at.

end_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) upper bound on created_at.

tools.name: campaign_spend
tools.title: Meta campaign spend
tools.description: Total Meta Ads spend for a date range, broken down by campaign and adset, from the synced meta_performance data.

start_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) lower bound on the report date.

end_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) upper bound on the report date.

campaign_name.description: Filter to a single campaign name (exact match).

tools.name: update_lead_qualification
tools.title: Update lead qualification
tools.description: Update the qualification of a 2026 lead: quality label, sales status, sales rep and/or sales comment.

lead_id.description: The id of the lead in form_submissions_2026.

kwaliteit.description: Quality label, e.g. Goed, Redelijk, Slecht.

sales_rep.description: Name of the responsible sales rep.
